item.title: MoneyTag: Income & Expense — Projects · Tags · Report | iOS App
item.description:
Income & Expense Every project keeps its own books: income minus expenses is its net result. Here are the questions people ask most. If yours is not answered, write to us — a real person reads every message. • Projects with their own net result • Tags that add up across projects • One currency per project • Live or manual rates • Apple Watch app • Home and Lock Screen widgets What exactly is a project? A project is a self-contained ledger: its own transactions, its own currency and its own bottom line. MoneyTag adds up the income, subtracts the expenses and shows the net result for that project alone. Does MoneyTag convert between currencies? Each project has its own base currency. On the Home screen, choose the input currency directly. MoneyTag uses public exchange rates refreshed about every 6 hours, or you can set a manual rate and later reset to automatic. The converted amount is saved in the project’s base currency, and saved rates remain available offline. Reference rates are provided by Frankfurter or ExchangeRate-API; for informational use. How do tags work? Tags are a first-class part of MoneyTag, not an afterthought. Tag any income or expense, and the Tags screen totals that same tag across all of your projects at once — income, expenses and the net for the tag. Cross-project tag analysis is part of Lifetime Pro. What is free, and what does Lifetime Pro add? Free · 1 project · 5 entries left. Unlimited projects, tags and reports — one purchase, yours forever. Export CSV · Export PDF · Export Photo · Backup & restore. What do the Apple Watch app and the widgets show? The Watch app lets you add a transaction from your wrist and see the current project's income, expenses and net. The widgets show that same status on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen. Projects, transactions, amounts, notes, tags, categories and settings stay in MoneyTag’s on-device storage and are not sent to Frankfurter / ExchangeRate-API. How do I export my ledger or move it to another device? Export CSV · Export PDF · Export Photo · Backup & restore. Includes projects, transactions, tags and settings. Projects, transactions, amounts, notes, tags, categories and settings stay in MoneyTag’s on-device storage and are not sent to Frankfurter / ExchangeRate-API. When automatic rates are on, MoneyTag sends the three-letter base-currency code and the necessary network request to api.frankfurter.dev / open.er-api.com. Frankfurter / ExchangeRate-API’s Cloudflare infrastructure may process the IP address, approximate region, interaction data and diagnostics. This processing is for app functionality and analytics, may be linked to you, is not used for tracking, and involves no advertising. Turn off automatic rates and use a manual rate to avoid these requests. Reference rates are provided by Frankfurter or ExchangeRate-API; for informational use.

item.description:
Five words. One minute. A trail you can actually see. Most vocabulary tools ask you to build decks before you learn anything, then bury you under a review queue that only grows. Wordmate Lite works the other way around. You open it, walk a five word pebble trail, and you are done for the day. The closing screen shows the exact five words you just learned, so one quiet minute always leaves something behind. It is built for adults who have started a language three times and stopped three times. Commuters with one free subway stop. Travelers packing next week. Students grinding through exam prep. Professionals who need the vocabulary of their own field. Anyone who wants a streak they can still keep on a bad day. Inside there are 44 learning languages and 14 life paths, including travel, business, exams, daily life, dining, shopping, interviews, health, tech, nature, entertainment and social talk, each broken into small units at beginner, intermediate and advanced level. Tap any word to hear it read aloud by the system voice, and pick the voice you prefer for each language. Save the words worth keeping, grouped by topic and level, and come back to them whenever you want. Set a daily goal of 5, 10, 15 or 20 words, then watch the count rise: how many days in a row you have kept going, your best run, today's words, progress in every language, and a small ring filling on each topic and unit. Everything runs offline. No account, no sign in, no personal data collected, no third party advertising, no tracking. What you learn stays on your device, on a plane, on a subway platform, in a waiting room with no signal. You can start without paying anything: one learning language and one path at beginner level stay open for good, and every other path stays visible so you always know what is there. A single one time purchase unlocks all 44 languages, all 14 paths, every level, unlimited learning and an unlimited saved word list. Buy it once and it stays yours. There is no subscription.
